# Factumation

> Free online invoice and quote generator for freelancers, self-employed, and SMBs in France, Madagascar, and French-speaking Africa.

## What is Factumation?

Factumation is a 100% free web application that lets professionals create, manage, and send professional invoices and quotes. No subscription, no hidden fees, no credit card required.

## Key Features

- Professional invoice and quote creation
- PDF export
- Multi-currency support: EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, CHF, MGA (Malagasy Ariary)
- Client management
- Email delivery with PDF attachment
- SIRET (France) and NIF/STAT (Madagascar) compliance
- Bilingual interface: French and English

## Target Audience

- Freelancers and self-employed professionals
- Auto-entrepreneurs (France)
- Small and medium businesses (PME)
- Professionals in France, Madagascar, and French-speaking Africa

## Pricing

Free. No paid plans. No feature restrictions.
